page.layout: One page of text, two left-margin notes beside the first lines of the column. The text column is one block. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Quòd". No running head.

main_text.p: per nondum - ortas controversias & negligentiorem cogitationem; de quâ Augustinus locis supra allatis. Sed statim deficit in eorum primo; quod est ex quinque secundum: de Morte Christi 3. De morte Christi pro omnibus. non pro omnibus quoad efficaciam, ut loquuntur, seu effectum & intentionem; licet pro omnibus quoad sufficientiam. Substituit enim Augustino Prosper A. Aquitanicus [?] Pro-sperum dogmatum illius tenacissimum, loquentem, de sufficientiâ quidem, his verbis: Redemtos per eam omnes: de fructu autem & efficacia, iftis; sed non omnes ex captivitate erutos. Ita esse, intelligitur ex inspecto contextu Responsionis, ad objectionum Vincentianarum cap.pri-mum Semipelagianum tale: Quòd Domi-nus noster Iesus Christus, non pro omnium sa-lute & redemtione hominum sit passus. Re-sponsio est: Contra vulnus originalis pec-cati, quo in Adam omnium hominum corru-pta natura est, &c. verum ac potens, & singu-lare remedium est, mors filii Dei: qui liber à mortis debito, & solus absq; peccato, pro pec-catoribus & debitoribus mortuus est.

page.notes: The left margin carries a mark "3." above the note "De morte Christi pro omnibus." The second margin note, "Prosper A. Aquitanicus", is badly worn; the reading of the abbreviated name is doubtful and is marked [?]. The small marks "ʒʒ" at the left of the italic quotation lines are printer's quotation ornaments, not text, and are not transcribed. The printed "cap.pri-mum" and "Quòd" are as printed. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
